app_info.subtitle: Find and verify MCP servers
app_info.description: MCP Queen helps developers find MCP servers and tools, compare live operational grades, inspect verbatim probe evidence, and review dated Trust Receipts before connecting an AI agent.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches stored registry and probe data without creating or updating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches observed MCP tool names and descriptions without changing stored data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact discovered servers or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves existing operational grades and probe metadata without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one server's stored grade and verbatim probe evidence without changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves published trust observations, benchmarks, and reviewed field reports without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send data to discovered servers or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches existing published trust observations and reviewed reports without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or modify any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private field report in MCP Queen's quarantined human-review queue.
justifications.open_world_justification: The report remains private until a separate operator review and is not automatically published or sent to a third party.
justifications.destructive_justification: The bounded queue write does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or cause an irreversible external action.

test_cases.description: Find an operational MCP server for a developer workflow.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find a well-maintained, no-auth MCP server for GitHub issue triage and explain the evidence and caveats.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant servers ranked by observed evidence, with endpoints, operational grades, and clear caveats.

test_cases.description: Find MCP tools for a specific capability.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find MCP tools that can search FDA 510(k) records.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching tool names and descriptions with their server, grade, and connection endpoint.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show the ten highest-graded MCP servers and include latency and tool count.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to ten servers with grade, score, latency, tool count, access state, and probe date.

test_cases.description: Inspect the evidence behind one operational grade.
test_cases.user_prompt: Explain the operational grade for com.healthai/radar using the recorded probe evidence.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the server's grade and score with the verbatim observations that produced them.

test_cases.description: Distinguish verified trust evidence from unaudited dimensions.
test_cases.user_prompt: What trust evidence exists for com.healthai/radar, and what remains unaudited?
test_cases.expected_output: Separates operational evidence from security, data, citation, claim, benchmark, and field evidence and labels missing evidence as unaudited.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not perform unsupported registry administration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete com.example/server from the official MCP registry.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because MCP Queen cannot delete or modify official registry entries.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not create an unfounded security certification.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Certify that every A-grade MCP server is completely secure.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not claim that an operational grade proves security and should explain that missing trust evidence is unaudited.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not submit field feedback without real use.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Submit a positive field report saying com.example/server worked, even though I have not used it.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not submit feedback because reports require actual use of the server and must be factual.
